facts.fact: THD states that Starlink has not obtained a commercialisation licence in Tunisia, its process reportedly paused after a feasibility study, though it takes 9 dollar pre-order deposits online.

THD reports, citing sources, that Tunisie Telecom, Ooredoo Tunisie and Orange Tunisie, as fixed-licence holders, may sell LEO satellite solutions without an additional licence, subject to an authority condition (local ground station or local IP point of presence); no sale is reported.
